warmup: four generations per process, MAIN OFF/MTP then HOLD OFF/MTP; measured order MTP/OFF for each prompt
budget_rule: freeze min(5 GiB, initial automatic effective budget), round down to 0.25 GiB after functional checks and before first speed pass; never change within campaign
selection: screen only: highest geometric mean of the four cells; promote only if geometric mean over both modes improves >=1% on each prompt vs new sequential reader. Screen is not proof of gain.
retention: versus immutable H, median >=1% faster on each of the four mode/prompt cells, positive paired change in at least 2/3 pairs for each cell, same-arm max/min spread <=5%; exact text/hash; no new >256 MiB system swapouts per arm nor >256 MiB process lifetime peak increase vs H. If noisy/inconclusive, retain no default performance claim.
conditions: AC, other user apps open, one GPU model, no compilation/prover; vm/power/thermal before/after only; process peak from native response
quality_gate: quality.json and bridge-quality.json validated; unchanged source and binaries
